verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a SaaS spend-and-expense platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency for customer data. The mention of US-based bank funding accounts concerns payment methods, not data storage location, and earns no credit.
